description: place_search — country-level result for the United States, for the call shape where the skill walks the place hierarchy from the top before narrowing (placeName='United States'). Predicate is '~United States' on placeName, which does NOT match a call passing placeName='Pennsylvania' with contextName='United States' — that one falls through to place-search-pennsylvania. Declare this before the catch-all and after any county-specific fixture. Added because the unmatched call was scoring Correctness and Tool Arguments to 1 on ut_search_external_sites_007 (run log v1_2026-09-22_07-05-19), failing the test on a fixture gap rather than on the log-entry behavior it exists to grade.
